x-global-obligations: Require approved versioned deployment policy; deny mixed Authorization bearer plus app cookie before selecting authentication.
Exact same-origin Origin and session/preauth-bound CSRF on cookie mutations. No credentialed cross-origin CORS; never reflect Origin.
All auth responses/errors are no-store. Suppress request/response tokens, callback query and Set-Cookie from logs.
All SQL, cryptographic verification, entropy, secret hashing, cookie delivery and current principal revocation remain adapter obligations.
